from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyOperatingProfit(BaseModel):
    """Operating profit information extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the financial document")
    operating_profit_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label as written in the document (e.g., '营业利润')")
    operating_profit_value: float | None = Field(description="The operating profit amount in yuan, with negative values for losses")
    profit_unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the reported amount (e.g., '元', '百万元', '百万元已换算为元')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period covered by this document")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the operating profit figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_profit_data: list[CompanyOperatingProfit]
